steps.title: Deliver the six mandatory LZA v1.16.1 config files at the repository-root config/
steps.intent: Deliver, at the repository-root config/ (workload #111 states 'All delivered work lands in the main repo, not in the inputs/ folder' — this redo corrects the prior attempt lza-phase0-1, which mistakenly wrote inputs/lza-phase0/config/), exactly the six mandatory LZA desired-state files (accounts, global, iam, network, organization, security) and nothing else there — no customizations-config.yaml (REP-001). Every key name must be one the pinned Landing Zone Accelerator v1.16.1 release (tag v1.16.1, commit 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab) actually accepts, confirmed against the checked-out release source under vendor/lza rather than from memory (CFG-005/CFG-006). The files carry the Phase 0 credential-free posture (REQ-049/REQ-051): homeRegion, enabledRegions and controlTower.landingZone.version stay consistent with lza.lock; the iam and network extension collections are empty; and the central security services (macie, guardduty, securityHub, detective, auditManager) plus the AWS Config recorder, delivery channel and aggregation are disabled so LZA provisions nothing. global-config.yaml is aligned to the reviewed, schema-validated example set, which includes useV2Stacks: true (LZACFG-039: use version-2 stacks when supported by the pinned release) — the sole content difference between today's root config/ and that validated set. Reserved machinery (.github/**, scripts/**, schemas/**, dashboard/**, package manifests) and the governance record (plans/**, confirmations/**, evidence/**) are out of scope and must not be touched; the example prototypes under inputs/lza-phase0/ are read-only reference, not a delivery target.
steps.acceptance: config/ at the repository root contains exactly the six mandatory files and no customizations-config.yaml; all six parse as YAML and every key is accepted by the pinned LZA v1.16.1 config source (confirmed against vendor/lza, not from memory); the iam/network extension collections are empty; the central security services and the AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation are disabled; global-config homeRegion, enabledRegions and controlTower.landingZone.version agree with lza.lock; and global-config sets useV2Stacks: true per LZACFG-039.
steps.stand_in: The reviewed six-file set from inputs/lza-phase0/config/ — recorded by the prior review (plan/lza-phase0-1/v1) as accepted by pinned LZA v1.16.1 with every key valid and no required key missing — delivered to the repository-root config/, including useV2Stacks: true (LZACFG-039). Account emails kept as the existing management+govcloud@example.com / logarchive+govcloud@example.com / audit+govcloud@example.com literals (a valid EmailAddress form that deploys nothing under the credential-free Phase 0 posture). Confirmation that every key is accepted by v1.16.1 is performed at build against vendor/lza, since the pinned validator cannot run in the read-only planning environment.

verification_targets.check: The repository-root config/ holds exactly the six mandatory LZA files (accounts/global/iam/network/organization/security-config.yaml) and no customizations-config.yaml.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'set -e; d=config; test -d "$d"; test "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 6; for n in accounts global iam network organization security; do test -f "$d/$n-config.yaml"; done; test ! -e "$d/customizations-config.yaml"'

verification_targets.check: All six config files under the repository-root config/ parse as YAML.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml,glob; ps=sorted(glob.glob("config/*.yaml")); assert len(ps)==6, ps; [yaml.safe_load(open(p)) for p in ps]'

verification_targets.check: global-config.yaml sets useV2Stacks: true (LZACFG-039), matching the reviewed schema-validated example set. This is the net content correction of the redo and is absent from today's root config/.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; g=yaml.safe_load(open("config/global-config.yaml")); assert g.get("useV2Stacks") is True'

verification_targets.check: Phase 0 credential-free posture: iam/network extension collections are empty and the central security services (macie, guardduty, securityHub, detective, auditManager) and the AWS Config recorder, delivery channel and aggregation are disabled.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; L=lambda n: yaml.safe_load(open(f"config/{n}-config.yaml")); iam=L("iam"); net=L("network"); sec=L("security"); assert all(iam[k]==[] for k in ("providers","policySets","roleSets","groupSets","userSets")); assert all(net[k]==[] for k in ("transitGateways","vpcs","vpcTemplates","vpcPeering")); assert sec["awsConfig"]["enableConfigurationRecorder"] is False and sec["awsConfig"]["enableDeliveryChannel"] is False and sec["awsConfig"]["aggregation"]["enable"] is False; assert all(sec["centralSecurityServices"][s]["enable"] is False for s in ("macie","guardduty","securityHub","detective","auditManager"))'

verification_targets.check: global-config homeRegion, enabledRegions and controlTower.landingZone.version agree with lza.lock (no drifting version/Region literal).
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; lock=yaml.safe_load(open("lza.lock")); g=yaml.safe_load(open("config/global-config.yaml")); assert g["homeRegion"]==lock["homeRegion"]=="us-gov-west-1"; assert g["enabledRegions"]==[lock["homeRegion"]]; assert str(g["controlTower"]["landingZone"]["version"])==str(lock["controlTowerLandingZoneVersion"])=="4.0"'

verification_targets.check: accounts-config declares exactly the three mandatory accounts Management (OU Root), LogArchive (OU Security) and Audit (OU Security), with workloadAccounts empty (LZACFG-010..013).
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; a=yaml.safe_load(open("config/accounts-config.yaml")); m={x["name"]:x["organizationalUnit"] for x in a["mandatoryAccounts"]}; assert m=={"Management":"Root","LogArchive":"Security","Audit":"Security"}, m; assert a["workloadAccounts"]==[]'

verification_targets.check: organization-config enables the organization and declares exactly the Security and Infrastructure OUs (LZACFG-020..021).
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; o=yaml.safe_load(open("config/organization-config.yaml")); assert o["enable"] is True; assert [u["name"] for u in o["organizationalUnits"]]==["Security","Infrastructure"]'

boundary_cases.description: Delivery target is the repository-root config/ ONLY (workload #111: 'All delivered work lands in the main repo, not in the inputs/ folder'). The prior attempt lza-phase0-1/v1 wrote inputs/lza-phase0/config/ instead; this redo must write root config/ and must not modify inputs/lza-phase0/ (read-only reference) nor any reserved machinery (.github/**, scripts/**, schemas/**, dashboard/**, package manifests) or governance record (plans/**, confirmations/**, evidence/**).

config/ must hold exactly the six mandatory files — no seventh file and specifically no customizations-config.yaml (REP-001). A build that adds an extra file, or omits one of the six, fails the delivery even if each file present is individually valid.

Every key name must be one the pinned LZA v1.16.1 release actually accepts, confirmed against the checked-out release source under vendor/lza — never invented from memory (CFG-005), and the live deployment is never used as schema trial-and-error (CFG-006). A key that is YAML-valid but rejected by the pinned config source fails the delivery.

Phase 0 is the credential-free tracer (REQ-049/REQ-051): the delivered config must leave the iam/network extension collections empty and every central security service plus the AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation disabled, so LZA would provision nothing. Enabling any of them here is a regression against LZACFG-050/060/070..074.

Five of the six root config files already match the reviewed schema-validated example set byte-for-byte and already meet the Phase 0 posture; the single net change is adding useV2Stacks: true to global-config.yaml (LZACFG-039). Expect most verification targets to already hold on the current tree — this is a confirm-and-align redo, not a value rewrite. The build must NOT regress the already-correct posture, and the only content difference a reviewer should see is the useV2Stacks line (plus any key correction the vendored v1.16.1 source turns out to require).
